verdict.rationale: Adyen docs confirm configurable payout timing per seller via managed payout schedules applied to balance accounts, and 'custom payouts' giving full control over timing, plus CashOut for instant access to funds. However, no explicit documentation of granular options like daily/weekly/monthly/manual schedule presets or instant payouts specifically to cards/real-time rails per seller — these are only implied via generic 'custom settlement and payout times' language. missing for 10: explicit schedule granularity options (daily/weekly/monthly/manual), explicit instant-payout-to-card mechanics distinct from CashOut, per-seller configuration UI/API specifics.
